tools.name: launch_breakout
tools.description: Launches the retro Atari Breakout game inside the conversation window. Use this when the user mentions playing breakout, starting a game, or wanting to see the interactive breakout app.

tools.name: get_game_config
tools.description: Internal tool called by the game UI on load to retrieve starting configurations. Do not invoke this tool directly unless inspecting default settings.

tools.name: get_breakout_settings
tools.description: Retrieves the current live configuration of your active game session.

tools.name: update_game_settings
tools.description: Live-updates parameters of the active Breakout game. You can use this to make the game easier or harder based on user request (e.g. widening the paddle, slowing down the ball, adding lives, or enabling AI Autopilot).

paddleSize.description: The width of the paddle in pixels. Default is 120. Set to 200 or 250 to make it wider/easier.

ballSpeed.description: The speed of the ball. Default is 5. Lower (e.g. 3) makes it slower/easier, higher (e.g. 8) makes it faster/harder.

lives.description: Total player lives. Default is 3. Set to 5 or 10 to give the player more chances.

autopilot.description: Whether to enable AI Autopilot mode where the paddle automatically tracks the ball.

godMode.description: Enable God Mode where the ball bounces automatically at the bottom of the screen instead of falling out.

tools.name: modify_breakout_settings
tools.description: Allows you to live-adjust gameplay physics and rules. You can make the paddle wider, speed up or slow down the ball, add lives, or turn on autopilot/god mode.

paddleWidth.description: The width of the paddle in pixels. Default is 120. Set to 200 or 250 to make it wider/easier.

tools.description: Activates a fun arcade cheat code inside the active game.

cheat.description: The name of the cheat code to activate.
